fact: In April 2026 the Ministry of ICT and National Guidance convened a consultative workshop with stakeholder groups, after regional focus-group consultations in Kampala, Kabale, Soroti and Gulu, to shape the National AI & Emerging Technologies Strategy, with a validation workshop planned for May 2026.
title: Uganda Artificial Intelligence Readiness Assessment Report
publisher: UNESCO / Ministry of ICT and National Guidance
